analytics.name: Analytic 1795
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect SMS Messages by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate API Calls via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: ContentResolver.query(Telephony.Sms) including both inbox]; Network Traffic Flow via Android Enterprise Network Logging / Enterprise VPN [DevicePolicyManager.retrieveNetworkLogs(): DnsEvent / ConnectEvent; VPN flow metadata]; Permissions Request via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Default SMS app, approved SMS backup apps. Keep minimal.
Default 10KB — SMS messages are ~500 bytes; even 20 with 2FA codes is high-confidence exfil.

log_sources.name: mobile:DynamicAnalysis
log_sources.channel: Dynamic API/runtime trace: ContentResolver.query(Telephony.Sms) including both inbox

analytics.name: Analytic 1796
analytics.guidance: For iOS, detect SMS Messages by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application State via Apple MDM [InstalledApplicationList / ManagedApplicationList]; Host Status via Apple MDM [DeviceInformation / SecurityInfo / ProfileList / restrictions and compliance queries]; Network Traffic Flow via Apple Network Extension / Enterprise VPN [NEFilterFlow / per-app VPN / secure-web-gateway flow metadata]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Messages (SMS), WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram — apps that use sms.db or have message value.
Default 10KB — even high-value targeted message grabs are small; full inbox dumps are larger.

log_sources.name: iOS:MDM
log_sources.channel: DeviceInformation / SecurityInfo / ProfileList / restrictions and compliance queries
